differences.native: LeetCode observes the Salary table after the single UPDATE statement and therefore needs no result query.
differences.app: The offline runner executes the identical UPDATE and then selects Salary in id order so authored cases can observe the mutated table.
differences.rationale: The appended read-only SELECT is required by the function-style offline result channel. It does not alter the update expression, affected rows, stored values, or linear mutation complexity.
